candidates.comment: Clear chunky wooden banjo in matching soft casual style; good pink background and floor, but the neck enters the top safe area.

defects: Four strings converge awkwardly at the headstock and do not clearly connect to the four tuning pegs.
Tuning hardware and string anchors are decorative rather than functional: the strings appear attached to small pins on the face instead of to the side pegs.
Some fret bars are slightly warped and unevenly spaced along the neck.

candidates.comment: Readable and well styled, but the composition is too tight with little surface/interior depth and the headstock is too close to the top.

defects: Headstock has mismatched/extra tuning knobs: two on the left but about three on the right, while only four strings are present.
Strings do not clearly connect to matching tuning pegs; several terminate or merge near the headstock instead of wrapping around posts.
Tuning posts/knobs are irregularly placed and asymmetric between the two sides of the headstock.
The bridge appears too short and slightly misplaced, not clearly supporting all strings.

candidates.comment: Strong readable banjo with good category-3 floor and pink wall; slight metal rim is acceptable, but the top safe area is not free.

defects: Tuning hardware is inconsistent: four side tuner knobs are visible, but three round posts/caps appear on the headstock face and do not clearly match the strings.
Some strings do not terminate cleanly at individual tuning posts; they appear to converge or disappear near the headstock.
String count appears inconsistent along the instrument, with more/clearer string lines on the body than can be matched to the headstock hardware.
Frets are rendered as thick raised bands wrapped around the neck rather than thin metal fret wires set into the fingerboard.
The neck-to-body joint is slightly melted into the rim/body instead of having a clear constructed heel joint.

judge.fix: Leave more empty pink background above the banjo so the top 12% is completely clear.
